column1: # Partition table for project WITHOUT OTA
# Bootloader will load code from ota_0 partition
# otadata partition is kept just to keep memory offsets equal to the OTA version
# Memory addresses (offsets) start at the value configured in menuconfig.
# Addresses 0x1000 to CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_OFFSET store the bootloader.
# Partitions of type app have to be placed at offsets aligned to 0x10000.
# Other types have to be placed at offsets aligned to 0x1000.
# NVS is used to store data (from application
